articles.summary: Stock Yards Bancorp promotes 35-year banking veteran William Otten to chief credit officer on April 1, 2026, as Bill Dishman becomes senior advisor before retiring.
articles.title: Stock Yards Bancorp Announces Promotion of William Otten to Chief Credit Officer of the Company as William Dishman Sets Retirement Date

articles.summary: Piper Sandler names Stock Yards Bancorp one of 24 Sm-All Star banks for 2025, citing top metrics in growth, profitability and credit quality for the $9.31B bank.
articles.title: Stock Yards Bancorp Named to Piper Sandler Sm-All Stars: Class of 2025 List for Small-Cap Banks

articles.title: Stock Yards Bank & Trust announces Bowling Green Market President with deep community ties
